The user authorized local implementation only. State completion status, what can continue and what cannot be claimed. No tools are available in this scenario.
A user asks for a new commercial app but only has a proposed solution and no customer evidence. Use the skill to produce a product plan only. What do you deliver and what stays unvalidated?

The accepted product, design and architecture are current. The user authorizes a local non-sensitive filter change. Apply the lifecycle without repeating discovery, redesigning the brand or migrating the stack.

The user requests the commercial design-to-development workflow, but Figma and specialized design skills are unavailable. Explain a useful local fallback and limits without inventing tool access or blocking all authorized preparation.

cases.prompt: A local app has UI and API consumers of a shared contract. Only the shared contract changed since the last integration baseline. Plan which checks to select from a reviewed dependency map, how to explain the selection, and what to do if the map is incomplete.

A developer makes several small UI edits and complains that every edit reruns the whole acceptance suite. Explain quick, integration and release execution without weakening commercial acceptance or project-required CI.

A previously green test has the same source commit, but the runtime, lockfile and a real external service changed. Can a local result cache skip it? Explain input validity, unknown/global fallback and live-service test handling.

A deterministic local check hit the result cache. Then a --fresh execution on the same key failed, and covered source changed while a later execution was running. Explain status/provenance, cache invalidation and remaining acceptance work.

Several commits accumulated after the last successful integration. There are also staged changes, an untracked test and a renamed/deleted source. A quick subset passed on the latest commit. Choose a safe comparison baseline and explain whether it can advance the integration baseline.

The affected quick checks all pass and integration results are cached. The user asks for a commercial readiness audit. Explain the remaining release checks and whether a planner/cache green can authorize production.
